notes.title: A big update to version 1.1.1!
notes.content:
Optimized game performance.
Fixed problems with displaying the cursor at the beginning of the level.
Fixed resume playback by pressing Esc.
Added a quick restart of the level by pressing "R".

Also available as a Bundle! Antizero Mini-Pack!!!

notes.content:

Therefore, we immediately update the game with the correction of critical errors

* Fixed the inability to download new levels under certain circumstances
* Level 3 reassembled

notes.title: Update 1.0.9 is available!
notes.content:
Greetings!
Update 1.0.9 is available!

* Added 8 music tracks!
* Fixed the incorrect operation of the "Sound" option. Now the sound is turned on / off in real time.
* Fixed platform exit beyond the monitor (virtual).
* Fixed small bugs on bonus levels.
* The problem with textures on the final video has been resolved.
* Changed the effect of missing some blocks.
* Added SSAO effect.
* Added effects for the death scene.

notes.title: Updates 1.08 with bonus levels!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We have released an update for version 1.08!
In this update we have added:
* 13 unique bonus levels with winter style!
* 3 achievements that can be earned on the bonus levels!

notes.title: A major update to version 1.0.4! Added achievements and many fixes
notes.content:
* Fixed incorrect work of teleports.
* Corrected the name of the levels.
* Fixed incorrect work bonus, which reduces the platform.
* Fixed incorrect display of the menu item.
* Supplemented New Game + mode.
* Added effect on receipt of bonuses.
* Adjusted probability of a bonus, "Heart."
* Adjusted points system.
* Achievements added!
